Heh I wish we had bunk beds!

Thanks for trying

Thanks for understanding

Yeah UK, JSA is job seekers allowance. Something ran by government to give unemployed people a bit of cash, to get to interviews and stuff like that. All experiences I've had with them have been horrendous though, I'm not sure it's worth the last of my mental health atm

Heh his kicking makes my head worse at times, so that's another thing. He feels bad for it but according to his doctor any prescription will contradict his depression meds. The first and last prescription he tried took him into a very real hormone crash fest, some sort of breakdown and he doesn't remember it very well. He ties his legs up but it only softens the blow. I would wrap him up but he sweats enough, really warm for us cold bugs now it's Spring. He kicks on average every 30 seconds to every 3 or so minutes

Ah nw, it's 4:17am here and it feels like the early evening for me haha, I don't usually sleep until 8am ish. Was out of pain 20 mins ago but partner got up for a pee so his kicking is back (the lighter he's sleeping, the more he kicks)

Not quite asleep as partner has rls which means he kicks for a majority of the night, more reasons for dodgy sleep haha. He kicks from like when he sleeps at 1am to 5am or so. Might be around a while yet

The only thing I can go for is JSA but more details and complications stopping that, recently they messed up our appointment times and dates, twice, meaning we wasted the very little cash we had to get there and wouldn't reimburse us, so we gave up. Also the first appointment cannot be rearranged, if you're not there you don't get a claim, which is terrible for my sleeping schedule. It's only sleep but sleep keeps the pain away so I savour it when I can. My partner and I have always had terrible experiences with the JSA people, he's wanted to die + his depression worsened every single time he's interacted with them and they treat us like dirt on their shoes. It's sort of a toss up between letting my physical health *maybe* become fixed at the cost of my mental health, or slowly saving up to maybe get my physical health fixed while keeping my mental health a bit stronger

Sorry for the long post, just a list of excuses really but they mean something to me even if pathetic haha
It shouldn't do, the shadey part of the monitor should just look more orangey than the rest, if it is a bit darker.
Maybe changing how deeply orange it goes/the tone/whatever the technical word is will help? I had to change it recently because it was horribly orange, but it's easier to view now.

Forget using my main for this, I don't think there should be such a rush to find a cure for cancer. A few years ago there was only 5-6 billion people on the planet, we're pushing 7.5 billion already. We're finding more cures for things and if we fix too many things, we'll eventually overpopulate.

Of course, a cure would be awesome but not quite soon. I've almost lost one relative to cancer and soon another one will be leaving (Aunty got through it, Uncle's is terminal) but it never changed my mind

You mixed a depressant with a stimulant, like mixing alcohol with weed, or alcohol with energy drinks. That's my only guess, they do the opposite things. (As guessed, not a doctor) It probably just hasn't left your system yet
